name: Example Activity
objective: One line: what this activity is for.
setup:
One line per bullet.
How the grid is laid out.
Who starts where and how it restarts.
rules:
Optional. One line per rule.
Touch limits, what counts as a foul.
scoring: Each team scores in its own goal. Write none if there is no scoring.
progression:
Optional. One line per step: Title (minutes) :: what changes.
Two touches (7 min) :: Play with a two touch limit.
One touch (7 min) :: Switch to one touch.
coach:
What to watch for :: What to ask the players about it.
A second cue :: A second question.
coach_note: Optional. How to coach it, not what to watch for. For example: do not dictate the choice, ask what they saw.
diagram_caption: Optional. Say in plain words what the diagram shows.
